remark: Added catch for RuntimeException to wrap runtime exceptions thrown by getConnection and dateToMillis into UserNotFoundException.
analysis: The code calls DbConnectionManager.getConnection() and StringUtils.dateToMillis(), which may throw various runtime exceptions such as NullPointerException, IndexOutOfBoundsException, SecurityException, etc. Currently, only SQLException is caught and wrapped in UserNotFoundException. If a runtime exception occurs (e.g., from getConnection or dateToMillis), it propagates uncaught, leaving the method inconsistent with its declared exception type. The finally block handles resource cleanup, but the method would throw an unexpected runtime exception to the caller. To improve robustness and consistency, runtime exceptions should be caught within the same try block and re-thrown as UserNotFoundException.
